## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Use a conventional PR title; it becomes the squash commit message.

## Validation

Describe tests and checks run, including relevant failure and edge cases.

## Risk and rollout

Describe compatibility, configuration, data changes, and rollback when applicable.

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior where useful.
- [ ] Documentation updated for changes to behavior, setup, or public contracts.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or private configuration included.
